achievements.name: Miner
achievements.description: Complete your first mission.

steps: Drop into any mission from the Space Rig terminal.
Finish objectives and extract successfully.

achievements.name: Stepping It Up
achievements.description: Survive a Hazard Level 3 mission from start to finish.

steps: Select Hazard Level 3 on the mission terminal.
Complete the mission from drop to extract without aborting.

achievements.name: Hit 'em Where It Hurts
achievements.description: You scored 1000 weakspot hits. Impressive.

steps: Target glowing weak points on large enemies (Praetorian rear, Oppressor armor plates, etc.).
Score the required weak-point hits / kills in a mission.

achievements.name: Performance Matters
achievements.description: Complete 10 Milestones.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Feelin' Perky
achievements.description: Unlock 10 Perk Nodes.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Approved Greenbeard
achievements.description: Complete your first assignment.

steps: Open the Assignment Board on the Space Rig.
Finish every stage of your first assignment chain.

achievements.name: Consistent Performance
achievements.description: Successfully complete three Hazard Level 3 missions from start to finish in a row.

steps: Set mission Hazard to 3 at the terminal.
Successfully complete the required streak of Hazard 3 missions without failing the streak.

achievements.name: Designated Decoy
achievements.description: You took the most damage from a Dreadnought out of your whole team.

steps: Fight a Dreadnought and keep aggro / soak hits.
Deal more damage taken from the Dreadnought than any teammate before it dies.

achievements.name: Management Approves
achievements.description: Complete 25 Milestones.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Now We Have  A BET-C
achievements.description: Defeat and fix a BET-C.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Self Control
achievements.description: Successfully play 10 consecutive missions without kicking a single barrel on the Space Rig.

steps: Before missions, do not kick any barrels on the Space Rig.
Complete 10 missions in a row without a single barrel kick between them.
warnings: Any barrel kick on the Rig resets the consecutive counter.

achievements.name: Thick-Skinned
achievements.description: Survive a Hazard Level 4 mission from start to finish.

steps: Select Hazard Level 4 on the mission terminal.
Complete the mission from drop to extract without aborting.

achievements.name: State Of The Art
achievements.description: You purchased a Mod in every tier for one of each upgradable item in the Equipment Terminal for the same character.

steps: Pick one dwarf and open the Equipment Terminal.
Buy a mod in every tier for each upgradable weapon/tool/armor slot on that dwarf.

achievements.name: Barrel Rider
achievements.description: Ride a barrel in the spacerig for three seconds.

steps: During a mission, mount/stay on the target: Ride a barrel in the spacerig for three seconds.
Stay mounted for the full timer — combat does not cancel progress if you stay on.

achievements.name: Advanced Robotics
achievements.description: You purchased a Mod in every tier for Bosco.

steps: Open Bosco’s upgrades on the Space Rig.
Purchase a mod in every available Bosco upgrade tier.

achievements.name: Exploring My Options
achievements.description: You unlocked a new primary and secondary weapon for the same character.

steps: Unlock a new primary weapon for a dwarf (assignment / credits).
Also unlock a new secondary for the same dwarf.

achievements.name: Movin' On Up
achievements.description: Promote any Dwarf at least once.

steps: Level a dwarf to the promotion threshold and gather the required resources.
At the Memorial Hall / promotion terminal: Promote any Dwarf at least once.

achievements.name: Hi Ho, Silver - Away!
achievements.description: Ride Molly for 15 seconds.

steps: During a mission, mount/stay on the target: Ride Molly for 15 seconds.
Stay mounted for the full timer — combat does not cancel progress if you stay on.

achievements.name: Darwin Award
achievements.description: Sacrificed yourself to the Barrel Hoop while intoxicated.

steps: Buy beer at the Abyss Bar until you are intoxicated (drunk overlay).
Jump or fall into the Barrel Hoop so you “sacrifice” yourself while drunk.

achievements.name: Mustacho
achievements.description: Purchase five moustaches for one character.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Employee Of The Month
achievements.description: Successfully complete four Hazard Level 4 missions from start to finish in a row.

steps: Set mission Hazard to 4 at the terminal.
Successfully complete the required streak of Hazard 4 missions without failing the streak.

achievements.name: Bring Your A-Game
achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 3 mission from start to finish where no dwarf goes down and without ordering a resupply.

steps: Queue Hazard 3.
Complete the mission with no downs and no resupply orders.

achievements.name: That's Not How You Play This Game
achievements.description: Rubbish goes in the bin, not the intricate machinery of the Barrel Hoop!

steps: Pick up a barrel on the Space Rig.
Throw or kick rubbish/non-barrel junk into the Barrel Hoop machine (not a clean hoop score).

achievements.name: Going Deeper
achievements.description: Complete A Deep Dive

steps: Open the Deep Dive terminal on the Space Rig when the weekly dive is available.
Complete A Deep Dive.

achievements.name: Big Spender
achievements.description: What a team player. You've paid for 25 rounds at the Abyss Bar.

steps: At the Abyss Bar, buy rounds for the team (pay for other dwarves’ drinks).
Repeat until you have paid for 25 rounds total.

achievements.name: Barrel Kicker
achievements.description: Dat accuracy. You kicked ten barrels into the hoop without a single miss.

steps: On the Space Rig, play Barrel Hoop near the Abyss Bar.
Kick barrels into the hoop until you land 10 consecutive scores with no misses.

achievements.name: Pest Control
achievements.description: Participate in killing two Dreadnoughts within five minutes on Hazard Level 3 or higher.

steps: On Hazard 3+, engage two Dreadnoughts in the same mission stretch.
Kill both within five minutes of each other.

achievements.name: Mutated Scavenger
achievements.description: Successfully complete 20 missions tagged with Warnings from start to finish.

steps: Finish missions until you reach 20 successful completions (any type counts).
Progress is account-wide across dwarves.

achievements.name: Expert Miner
achievements.description: Complete 100 missions.

steps: Finish missions until you reach 100 successful completions (any type counts).
Progress is account-wide across dwarves.

achievements.name: Total Makeover
achievements.description: Customize each accessory slot of a character.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Mini Fixer
achievements.description: Fix 50 Mini M.U.L.E.s.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: See You Later, Detonator!
achievements.description: Participate in killing 20 Bulk Detonators.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Lone Wolf
achievements.description: You've completed 10 Solo missions. Impressive.

steps: Host or join a mission and play with no other dwarves in the lobby.
Complete a mission successfully while solo.

achievements.name: I Like It Down Here
achievements.description: You stayed in a mission for an hour or longer.

steps: Keep playing missions to raise your dwarf promotion / hazard progression.
Reach the required deep dive / hours threshold listed by the achievement.

achievements.name: Corporate Climber
achievements.description: Promote any two Dwarves at least once.

steps: Level a dwarf to the promotion threshold and gather the required resources.
At the Memorial Hall / promotion terminal: Promote any two Dwarves at least once.

achievements.name: Big Game Hunter
achievements.description: Participate in killing 40 Dreadnoughts.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: What Are These Things?
achievements.description: You've collected 5 mysterious alien artifacts. They are hot to the touch, and smells faintly of...tarmac?

steps: During missions, look for Error Cubes (alien artifacts) hidden in caves.
Deposit 5 Error Cubes across missions (they count when collected/deposited).

achievements.name: Good Shepherd
achievements.description: Successfully complete 25 missions where at least 1 player is 10 player ranks lower than you.

steps: Finish missions until you reach 25 successful completions (any type counts).
Progress is account-wide across dwarves.

achievements.name: Going Lethal
achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 5 mission from start to finish.

steps: Select Hazard Level 5 on the mission terminal.
Complete the mission from drop to extract without aborting.

achievements.name: Prospector
achievements.description: Collect 20 Compressed Gold Chunks.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Deep For Speed
achievements.description: Complete Any Deep Dive Under 45 Minutes

steps: Open the Deep Dive terminal on the Space Rig when the weekly dive is available.
Complete Any Deep Dive Under 45 Minutes.

achievements.name: It's My Party
achievements.description: You've hosted and successfully completed 50 team missions from start to finish.

steps: Host a multiplayer lobby (you are the host).
Successfully complete 50 hosted team missions from drop-in to extract.

achievements.name: Hat Trick
achievements.description: Promote any three Dwarves at least once.

steps: Level a dwarf to the promotion threshold and gather the required resources.
At the Memorial Hall / promotion terminal: Promote any three Dwarves at least once.

achievements.name: The A-Team
achievements.description: Through skillfull maneuvering, you put a barrel in every seat in the Drop Pod. Well done?

steps: Carry barrels into the Drop Pod on the Space Rig.
Place one barrel in every seat so all four seats have a barrel before launch.

achievements.name: Drill-by Shooting
achievements.description: Ride the Drilldozer with three other dwarves and kill 15 enemies each without leaving.

steps: On an Escort Duty mission, ride the Drilldozer with three other dwarves.
Each dwarf must kill 15 enemies without leaving the dozer.

achievements.name: Foreign Objects In The Launch Bay
achievements.description: You kicked every barrel into the Launch Bay. You are why Mission Control drinks.

steps: Kick every barrel on the Space Rig down into the Launch Bay pit.
Clear the platform so no barrels remain upstairs.

achievements.name: Farmer
achievements.description: Ride the Silicate Harvester for 30 seconds.

steps: During a mission, mount/stay on the target: Ride the Silicate Harvester for 30 seconds.
Stay mounted for the full timer — combat does not cancel progress if you stay on.

achievements.name: Disc Jockey
achievements.description: Play 25 songs on the jukebox. (songs must play to the end to count)

steps: Use the Space Rig jukebox and start a song.
Let each song play fully to the end — repeat until 25 songs have finished.

achievements.name: Full Team Ahead
achievements.description: Promote all four Dwarves at least once.

steps: Level a dwarf to the promotion threshold and gather the required resources.
At the Memorial Hall / promotion terminal: Promote all four Dwarves at least once.

achievements.name: Veteran Diver
achievements.description: Complete Any 5 Deep Dives

steps: Open the Deep Dive terminal on the Space Rig when the weekly dive is available.
Complete Any 5 Deep Dives.

achievements.name: Elite Diver
achievements.description: Complete An Elite Deep Dive

steps: Open the Deep Dive terminal on the Space Rig when the weekly dive is available.
Complete An Elite Deep Dive.

achievements.name: Jeweler
achievements.description: Collect 10 Bittergems.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Like A Well-Oiled Machine
achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 4 mission from start to finish where no dwarf goes down and without ordering a resupply.

steps: Queue Hazard 4.
Complete the mission with no downs and no resupply orders.

achievements.name: Silver-Tier Employee
achievements.description: Earn a Silver promotion.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Just Another Bug Hunt
achievements.description: Participate in killing two Dreadnoughts within 30 seconds on Hazard Level 3 or higher.

steps: On Hazard 3+, spawn or fight two Dreadnoughts close together (double-dread events / back-to-back).
Kill both within a 30-second window.

achievements.name: Rock Solid
achievements.description: Successfully complete five Hazard Level 5 missions from start to finish in a row.

steps: Set mission Hazard to 5 at the terminal.
Successfully complete the required streak of Hazard 5 missions without failing the streak.

achievements.name: Happy Feet
achievements.description: You spent an hour or more shaking your money maker.

steps: Stand on the Space Rig dance floor / jukebox area and keep dancing.
Accumulate one hour of dancing time across visits (progress stacks).

achievements.name: Gold-Tier Employee
achievements.description: Earn a Gold promotion.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Party Time!
achievements.description: You threw a toast to good music while in a full team.

steps: Load into the Space Rig with a full party of 4 dwarves.
While music is playing, throw a toast (salute / beer toast emote) with the group.

achievements.name: Roller Coaster
achievements.description: Grind on a pipe for 120 seconds without stopping.

steps: On a Pipeline / refining mission, grind on a completed pipe section.
Stay on the pipe continuously for 120 seconds without hopping off.

achievements.name: Time Well Spent
achievements.description: You stuffed every single barrel on the Space Rig into the Drop Pod. Management weeps.

steps: Gather every barrel on the Space Rig (bar, launch bay, walkways).
Stuff them all into the Drop Pod at once — none left outside.

achievements.name: Legendary Miner
achievements.description: Complete 500 missions.

steps: Finish missions until you reach 500 successful completions (any type counts).
Progress is account-wide across dwarves.

achievements.name: Karl Would Be Proud
achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 5 mission from start to finish where no dwarf goes down and without ordering a resupply.

steps: Queue Hazard 5 with a coordinated team (or very strong solo).
Finish the mission with nobody downed and without calling a resupply pod.

achievements.name: Bosco, You're The Best
achievements.description: You've completed 100 Solo missions. Most impressive.

steps: Play a solo mission so Bosco spawns as your helper drone.
Complete objectives while using Bosco’s mine/fight/light commands.

achievements.name: Pro-Team
achievements.description: Earn Silver Promotions for all four dwarves.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: Legendary-Team
achievements.description: Earn Gold Promotions for all four dwarves.

steps: Track progress in the Steam overlay / in-game stats as you play.

achievements.name: If Only I Got Paid For This...
achievements.description: In the Barrel Hoop game, achieve a score of 3000 or more in less than 100 kicks.

steps: Play Barrel Hoop on the Space Rig.
Reach a score of 3000 or more in fewer than 100 kicks.

achievements.name: Without A Paddle
achievements.description: You were the last dwarf standing, with no primary or secondary ammo left, just when a Dreadnought spawned. Some days you should just stay in bed...

steps: In a Dreadnought Elimination (or similar) mission, empty primary and secondary ammo.
Be the last dwarf alive when a Dreadnought spawns — team wipe helpers / solo with Bosco can set this up carefully.

achievements.name: Car Pool
achievements.description: Ride the Silicate Harvester with three other dwarves and kill five enemies each without leaving.

steps: Start a mission with four dwarves and find a Silicate Harvester.
All four ride it together; each dwarf must get 5 kills without dismounting.
